description: This PHP class defines a model for representing leave balance information within an HR management system. It implements serialization and normalization for API responses and encapsulates data such as entitled leave, used leave, scheduled leave, pending leave, total taken, remaining balance, and relevant dates.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceModel
classes.description: Represents a leave balance data model used in API responses, leveraging traits for serialization and normalization, and initialized with a LeaveBalance entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveBalanceModel with a LeaveBalance entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
